aim.derivation: gain = L_ban - L_men, PV = L_men - L_neu. With independent cell noise of variances s_b^2, s_m^2, s_n^2 and the SAME mention cell in both: cov(gain, PV) = -s_m^2, so the null corr(gain, PV) = -s_m^2 / sqrt((s_b^2 + s_m^2)(s_m^2 + s_n^2)) = -0.5 at equal variances. In exp7's split-half AIM the mention cells of the two halves share only the template-level (prompt) component, so the bias scales with that shared variance.

ess_weighted.mechanism: noise-corrected V terms: V_u = sum(a^2 - N_u) went negative (-35.4) after the ESS weights shrank the ladder projection below its noise allowance, so V_s / (V_u + V_s) = 181.3 / 145.9 > 1
